_doc: Hints for status names and raw result codes printed by the firmware (bsp_status_t names; rslt=0x.. = <drv>_last_rslt()). Keys: status name, 0xXXXXXXXX, or a negative vendor code as decimal. Add a line whenever a debug session explains a new code.
ERR_INIT: peripheral not initialised or its init failed - check the order (i2c0_init before the sensors)
ERR_BUS: transfer error - device answered its address but the transaction failed; see rslt
ERR_NODEV: no ACK / wrong chip id - wrong address, sensor unpowered, rework option, bus held
ERR_TIMEOUT: bounded wait expired - bus stuck (try reinit / i2c0_recover) or clock stretching
ERR_NODATA: polled faster than the sensor's data rate - lower the rate or wait for data-ready
ERR_HW_SETTING: connector / jumper / rework missing - see the component's hw_settings
-1: Bosch SensorAPI E_NULL_PTR - a driver object/callback is NULL
-2: Bosch SensorAPI E_COM_FAIL - bus transfer failed after init: check the bus handle lifetime (BMM350: cy_stc_i3c_device_t must stay alive - static), address, bus speed
-3: Bosch SensorAPI E_DEV_NOT_FOUND - chip id mismatch
-11: Bosch BMI2 self-test failed - keep the board still and flat during selftest
